title: Port Dopetrope base CSS and assets to shindo
description: Download html5up.net/dopetrope zip. Copy relevant images to web/themes/custom/shindo/images/ (bg textures, banner, icons, dividers). Port assets/css/main.css into shindo SCSS partials: base tokens (typography scale, font families, spacing), root color palette adjustments, base element styles. Populate scss/theme/_dopetrope.scss met de karakteristieke Dopetrope look (background image tiling, section dividers, overall visual identity). Import juiste Google Fonts via shindo.libraries.yml (Merriweather + Source Sans Pro of vergelijkbaar) tenzij dat via fontyourface loopt (bead lfy). Verify: ddev theme-build shindo, curl homepage laat Dopetrope-CSS zien.
notes:
Dopetrope base CSS + assets ported.
- Downloaded html5up dopetrope zip, extracted assets/css/images/bg.png (200x200 tileable texture) → web/themes/custom/shindo/images/bg.png
- scss/base/_reset.scss: full Meyer reset ported (v2.0) + box-sizing
- scss/base/_typography.scss: Source Sans Pro body, dark headings via --color-secondary-* HSL, colored links via --color-primary-* HSL met calc()-lightness hover, blockquote/hr/p rhythm
- scss/base/_tokens.scss: Dopetrope palette defaults als :root fallback (primary #d52349, secondary #252122, accent #43bff0, background #fff, text #5d5d5d), font vars, container-max 70em
- scss/theme/_dopetrope.scss: body krijgt dark bg met bg.png texture, .layout-container wordt de light 'page-wrapper' met max-width 70em, responsive gutters op xlarge/large/medium/small breakpoints (matcht Dopetrope originele SASS)
- shindo.libraries.yml: temp google-fonts library met Source Sans Pro (300/400/700/900/300italic). Note markeert dat lfy (fontyourface) dit later kan vervangen
- config/install/shindo.settings.yml: color defaults geüpdatet naar Dopetrope palette
- config/sync/shindo.settings.yml: active DB geüpdatet en geëxporteerd

Verified: ddev theme-build shindo compileert schoon; homepage HTML toont <html style='--color-primary-h:344;...'> met correcte Dopetrope HSL; Google Font geladen; bg.png referentie in gecompileerde CSS.

title: shindo theme: configurable colors (Olivero pattern)
description: Implement 5 color settings (primary, secondary, accent, background, text) as color_hex in config/schema/shindo.schema.yml. Add HTML5 color picker + hex textfield in theme-settings.php with #config_target. In preprocess_html: hex->HSL, inject as CSS custom properties on <html>. SCSS uses hsl(var(--color-primary-h) var(--color-primary-s) var(--color-primary-l)). Reference: /Users/boris/Sites/doesdesign/web/core/themes/olivero/theme-settings.php + olivero.theme.
notes: Configurable colors done, Olivero-inspired. config/schema/shindo.schema.yml declares 5 color_hex settings. config/install/shindo.settings.yml has defaults (#007acc primary etc). theme-settings.php uses #type=>color for each with #config_target binding — HTML5 native picker, no library dependency. shindo.theme adds shindo_preprocess_html + _shindo_hex_to_hsl helper (copied from Olivero). Brand colors (primary/secondary/accent) emit HSL components; utility colors (background/text) emit direct hex. scss/base/_typography.scss demonstrates hsl(var(--color-primary-h) ...) usage for link + hover with calc()-based lightness derivative. Verified end-to-end: temp-switched default to shindo, curl showed <html style='--color-primary-h:204;--color-primary-s:100%;--color-primary-l:40%;...'>. Restored denbei as default.

title: Onderzoek upgrade naar Drupal core 11.4
description: Core 11.3.16 → 11.4.4 is momenteel geblokkeerd door drupal/ckeditor_media_resize 1.1.0, dat alleen core ~10.5.0 || ~10.6.0 || ~11.2.0 || ~11.3.0 ondersteunt. Er is nog geen release van ckeditor_media_resize met 11.4 support (1.1.0 is de nieuwste, 1.1.x-dev bestaat). Onderzoek: (1) huidige status van het ckeditor_media_resize issue queue op drupal.org, (2) is er een patch of MR die 11.4 compat toevoegt, (3) alternatieven (bijv. core CKEditor Image resize plugin — lost dat dezelfde use case op?), (4) hoeveel places gebruikt de site dit module functioneel (grep in content/CKE profielen), (5) besluitpunt — wachten op release, patch toepassen, of module vervangen.
notes:
Onderzoeksresultaat:

## Status ckeditor_media_resize (v1.1.0, minimally maintained)
- Blokkeert core 11.4 upgrade
- Nieuwste release 1.1.0 (30 sep 2025), 1.1.x-dev laatste update 7 april 2026 — beide zonder 11.4 support
- Issue #3607786 op drupal.org: 'Add Drupal Core ~11.4.0 support' — RTBC (Reviewed & tested), status Critical sinds 19 juli 2026
- MR !30 door damienmckenna: pas core constraint aan naar '^10.5 || ~11.2.0 || ~11.3.0 || ~11.4.0' — getest door justcaldwell op 11.4.3 met CKE 47.6.2, werkt
- MR !30 is nog niet gemerged; maintainer heeft 'minimally maintained' status
- Andere open MRs (#31-#33) zijn alternatieve implementaties

## Lokaal gebruik op doesdesign
- Module is enabled (core.extension.yml)
- 4 view modes voor media/image: cke_media_resize_{small,medium,large,xl}
- 4 view displays + 4 image styles die deze modes gebruiken
- GEEN referentie in editor.editor.*.yml of filter.format.*.yml — dus de plugin zit niet in de CKE-toolbar; alleen de view modes worden gebruikt bij media embeds via de default core Media dialog

## Alternatieven in core
- Drupal 10.3+ heeft core CKEditor 5 Media Library integratie met resizable images (native image resize plugin in CKE5 core). Dat kan waarschijnlijk deze module vervangen zonder functionaliteitsverlies — moet nog getest worden.

## Aanbevolen actie (nog te bevestigen door mens)
1. Kortste pad: patch composer.json om MR !30 toe te passen (via cweagans/composer-patches: 'https://git.drupalcode.org/project/ckeditor_media_resize/-/merge_requests/30.patch'). Daarna kan 11.4 door.
2. Duurzamere weg: vervang ckeditor_media_resize door native core image resize + custom image styles. Verwijder module + 4 view modes/styles/displays. Meer werk nu, geen verdere afhankelijkheid van een 'minimally maintained' contrib module.

## Bronnen
- https://www.drupal.org/project/ckeditor_media_resize
- https://www.drupal.org/project/ckeditor_media_resize/issues/3607786
- https://git.drupalcode.org/project/ckeditor_media_resize/-/raw/1.1.x/ckeditor_media_resize.info.yml
- https://git.drupalcode.org/project/ckeditor_media_resize/-/merge_requests/30
close_reason: Research done. Findings saved in bead notes. Twee mogelijke wegen (patch MR!30 nu, of vervang door core native). Volgende bead nodig: beslissing + uitvoering.
